search_window.basis: Start equals completed_at of most recent verified 2026-10-26 11:46 Care Line Watch heartbeat, read from ops/watch-ledger; end is current supplementary recall run.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; production Care Line collector remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.scope: U.S., DC and territories. Hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary care; emergency/rural loss; ambulance/air-medical bases; CMS termination/rescission/CLIA access risk; confirmed effective restoration.

cms_public_notices.details: Official CMS Public Notices retrieved through canonical site search after an older CMS memo URL failed. The most recent notice listed remained 2026-10-23; no post-Oct-23 action visible.

targeted_queries: "October 26, 2026" "Guam" OR "Puerto Rico" OR "Virgin Islands" hospital services suspended clinic

search_failures.error: Outdated CMS landing URL inaccessible through the research tool; canonical CMS Public Notices was independently retrieved and fully available.
search_failures.coverage_impact: none to material CMS notice surveillance

coverage_notes.screening: No verified new U.S. or territorial clinical access closure, suspension, termination, or effective restoration indexed during the observation window. Search results included foreign non-U.S. service concerns, previously announced relocations, and speculative ownership/reopening plans.

excluded_examples.title: Tahoe Forest Health System Sierra Center service relocation
excluded_examples.reason: September announcement that urgent care, pharmacy and related services move October 26; not proof of new net access loss or unexpected reopening.

excluded_examples.title: Chicago Tribune report on prospective acquisition of West Suburban and Weiss hospitals
excluded_examples.reason: Existing historical hospital closures and prospective ownership transaction; no confirmed effective reopening. Syndication/mirror source.

excluded_examples.title: Dialysis concerns at Chittagong Medical College Hospital
excluded_examples.reason: Bangladesh outside U.S./territorial coverage; future contract expiration, not current concrete service closure.

duplicate_review.production_review: No positive candidates identified that would warrant full production queue duplicate verification.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search engine results may lag; this supplementary recall is not comprehensive and does not replace primary national collection. One obsolete CMS entry URL failed but canonical Public Notices coverage succeeded; degraded classification preserves that failure.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one private GitHub heartbeat; no approvals, publishing, primary production changes, schedule changes, or task disabling.
